record.title: Evaluate current derived proof for the unchanged descending survey
record.intent: Continue only from accepted actual software evidence and preserve final restoration.
requirements: Independently verify the complete actual observation and captured lease authority, relating the new epoch to the stopped introduction while retaining its incomplete transition status. Current proof must not be represented as successful completion of the interrupted controller.

If accepted, bind the unchanged 24-frequency, three-record descending survey and final stock rollback to the new actual observation plus the original exact introduction lineage. Preserve identical numerical treatment, weak or zero records, source100MHz cleanup, saved ordinary settings and one final stock reboot with its original verification and warm-up requirements.

Commit and push the conclusion before the next experiment. If acceptance or remaining reserve fails, record exact restoration limits and perform only an independently reviewed known-safe restoration within existing authorization.
acceptance: The actual derived survey boundary or exact remaining question is recorded.
